review_type: Independent still review of minimal left-dot waiting revision
dot_position_and_contact: One/two/three-dot groups now sit over the upper-left head edge. All visible dots appear to touch the coral top edge with minimal overlap; no intentional air gap is present. This matches the specified minimum-contact interpretation, not a floating-dot treatment.
spacing: Dots are individually legible and separated horizontally. The group occupies a small left corner rather than spanning the head. No clipping of the first or third dot is visible.
identity_and_scale: Body and tab proportions are very close to previous waiting; short broad coral form, inward chevrons except the blink, four legs and broad center gap are retained. Against approved idle, waiting remains slightly shorter and has upward-angled tabs; these differences read as pose variation rather than an identity change.
gesture: Raised short tabs plus restrained ellipsis cycle and blink convey gentle expectant waiting. Large body movement is not apparent in the still strip.
cleanliness: No bubble, connector circles, extra hands, detached body pieces, or visible clipping.
reported_connectivity_evidence: Supplemental connectivity check reports one component in each of six frames at alpha threshold 128; this was not independently recomputed for this visual review.
limitations: No playback timing, smoothness or realtime claim. Exact pixel connectivity not independently measured.
